name: slack
description: Reads Slack through Slack's official MCP server for what is waiting on you and what you are waiting on: unanswered DMs and mentions, and threads where you asked and got no answer. Read-only by the scopes granted to your token.

waiting-on-me.prompt: Use the waiting-on-me skill to find what is waiting on me on Slack.

waiting-on-them.prompt: Use the waiting-on-them skill to find what I am waiting on others for on Slack.

action-now.prompt: Use the waiting-on-me and action-now-or-soon skills to answer action-now: what I need to act on today on Slack.

action-soon.prompt: Use the waiting-on-me and action-now-or-soon skills to answer action-soon: what I need to act on soon on Slack.

all.prompt: Answer all four triage questions on Slack, following triage-report: action-now, action-soon, waiting-on-them, then the counts.
